shellCommands.command: git ls-files | grep -v node_modules | head -100 && cat package.json && git diff package.json

cd /workspace; for f in app/Dashboard.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; ls -R 01-app | head -80; grep -ril "relative url\|absolute URL" 01-app | head

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "parallel\|Promise.all" 01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md | head -120; grep -n -i -B3 -A10 "Route Handler.*Server Component\|calling.*route handler\|relative" 01-app/02-guides/backend-for-frontend.md | head -60
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
